claims.claim: Born 10 September 1995 in Columbus, Ohio; raised in North Lewisburg, New Albany, Mount Vernon
At 14 a teacher mentioned a talent show; professional a year later
Joined Wild 'N Out in 2015; TRL co-host and The Challenge in 2017; Black Pumpkin 2018; Bring the Funny 2019 eliminated week eight
Signed with CAA December 2022; Only Fans 2021; Walking Red Flag June 2023; Unwrapped Dec 2025
TikTok crowd work from summer 2022, 18 million followers Nov 2023
Natural Selection released 15 Nov 2023, filmed in Washington, D.C.; opening joke backlash; apology 20 Nov 2023 linking to helmet site
10.3 million views in two weeks, Top 10 in 42 countries; 600,000 tickets in under 48 hours; Dolby Theater, Mohegan Sun, Hollywood Bowl; two-special deal
Lucid released 13 Aug 2024, Comedy Zone Charlotte, first Netflix crowd work special; Walking Red Flag 13 million views
Stay Golden World Tour by Live Nation; Red Rocks 18 Oct 2026; 60+ shows in 10+ countries; final date Oklahoma City 29 Dec 2026
The Altruists, eight episodes, 19 Nov 2026; Rife plays Ryan Salame, series regular; casting reported 10 July 2025
Annabelle purchase Aug 2025 with Elton Castee, Monroe CT, about 750 items, five years; Spera says items leased; representative confirmed 2 Aug
AOL reports 2024 tour $60M, 733,000 tickets, 256 shows without naming a source; Celebrity Net Worth $40M; inconsistent Forbes $50M wording
